attorneys: Petitioner pro se., Ivan A. Elliott, Attorney General of Illinois, and William C. Wines, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Illinois is denied without prejudice to the filing of an application for writ of habeas corpus in any State court of competent jurisdiction. See Young v. Ragen, 337 U. S. 235.
